_source: SZS C5 Konstruktionstabellen, revision 2018, reprinted 2021: ExternalFiles/000-Normes/SZS-C5-2021.pdf (the engineer's copy is 301-Normes/SZS-C5-2018.pdf), printed page 154 (PDF page 160), «Kurzbezeichnungen für EDV-Anwendungen» / «Abréviations pour le traitement informatique des données», block «Profile und Bleche» / «Profilés et tôles». Read off a render of the page; the German and French names are the page's own words.
_note: The profile families a position's `section type` may name for a steel element (docs/domain/positions.md §7). Only the families the engineer chose are here -- the page also lists Riffelbleche, Gitterroste, Kranschienen, Slim-Floor-Deckenträger and Wabenträger -- and only their codes and names: no profile table of SZS C5 is transcribed, a steel position's dimension being the designation's size as it is written («200» for IPE 200, «101.6x10» for ROR 101.6×10). The order is the engineer's, grouped by family, where the page's is alphabetical. «HL» stands for the page's «HL..» (HLA, HLB, ...); «L» joins the page's two lines (equal and unequal angles) into one name, and «RRK»/«RRW» leave out the page's «früher RAUTA, VHP» / «früher MSH, RHS, TPS». ⚠️ The page is printed in German and French only: the English names are a translation, not the norm's.
